narrative.benchmark_md:
The peer set is locked at the research phase (Phase 0) and immutable thereafter, ensuring scoring is referenced to a consistent comparison group. The Towne Insurance peer set comprises four institutions, each fulfilling a distinct benchmarking role: Starkweather & Shepley (SIZE_MATCH — direct-revenue analog), The Hilb Group (ASPIRATIONAL — same broker model at larger scale), Holmes Murphy (ASPIRATIONAL — independent ESOP model), and OneDigital (DIGITAL_BENCHMARK — Salesforce FSC reference customer via Zennify implementation).
Peer scores are estimated using comparable evidence collection across the same 701 capability. Estimated peer overall scores: S&S 2.77, Hilb 2.93, Holmes 2.79, OneDigital 3.25, yielding a peer median of approximately 2.90.
